title: Questions & Answers
intro: Choosing camp comes with questions. Here are a few answers to get started. If you want to talk about your camper or your own situation, reach out.

items.question: Does my child need to have their identity figured out?
items.answer: No. Camp welcomes LGBTQ+ and questioning kids. There is no test of being “queer enough.” If you’re wondering whether camp is a fit, talk with our team.

items.question: Is this a gender education program?
items.answer: It’s summer camp. Swimming, arts and crafts, games, campfires, and friendships fill our days. Queerness is centered in our community and is also something we share in the background.

items.question: How are bunks assigned?
items.answer: Bunks are organized by grade level and take camper needs into account. We do not divide campers by binary gender. Talk with our team about your camper’s comfort and needs.

items.question: What if we can’t afford tuition or the deposit?
items.answer: No camper is turned away for inability to pay. If tuition or the deposit is a barrier, talk with Dan about scholarship support.

items.question: Do campers need to be Jewish?
items.answer: No. Our founders drew on their experience in Jewish summer camping. Indigo Point welcomes campers of all faiths and none.

items.question: Can campers bring phones?
items.answer: Campers leave phones, internet, and video games behind to spend time together in person. Music players, audiobooks, and digital cameras are allowed. Ask us about staying in touch or accessibility needs.

items.question: How do we discuss health needs or accommodations?
items.answer: Email shira@campindigopoint.org before registering to discuss medication, access needs, sensory needs, and other support. Camp is an overnight summer camp rather than a therapeutic program; we can talk through whether it is a good fit.

items.question: How can we learn about the Colorado teen program?
items.answer: Visit our Colorado page, then email info@campindigopoint.org for the next dates, age range, tuition, and registration information.

items.question: How is my donation used?
items.answer: Gifts support scholarships and camp operations: helping kids get here and supporting the people and experiences that make camp possible.

items.question: Why does the donation form say Ashrei Foundation?
items.answer: The Ashrei Foundation is Camp Indigo Point’s 501(c)(3) fiscal sponsor. Our donation link opens their DonorPerfect form specifically for Camp Indigo Point.

items.question: How do I apply to work at camp?
items.answer: Email shira@campindigopoint.org to ask about current openings and the application process. Our team can share role requirements, compensation, dates, training, and next steps.
